name: master-slave
description: Pair an Arisa Master with deterministic headless Arisa Slave hosts over an authenticated encrypted direct TCP connection.

listenHost.prompt: IP literal on which the Master listener binds.

listenPort.prompt: TCP port on which the Master listener binds.

publicEndpoint.prompt: Reachable tcp://IP:port endpoint published in Slave bootstrap URLs.

bootstrapSecretTtlMs.prompt: Lifetime of a one-use bootstrap secret in milliseconds.

maxFrameBytes.prompt: Maximum encrypted protocol frame size in bytes.

maxCatalogTools.prompt: Maximum number of tools accepted in a Slave capability catalog.

maxJobOutputBytes.prompt: Maximum accumulated output for one remote job in bytes.

maxReadBytes.prompt: Maximum bytes returned by one remote file read.

maxDirectoryEntries.prompt: Maximum entries returned by one remote directory listing.

maxProcessTimeoutMs.prompt: Maximum timeout allowed for a remote process.

jobTtlMs.prompt: Lifetime of an issued remote job in milliseconds.

batchConcurrency.prompt: Maximum number of simultaneous jobs in a batch.

streamBufferBytes.prompt: Maximum pending stream data before backpressure is applied.

offlineWarningMs.prompt: Delay before Master emits a deduplicated offline warning.

roots.prompt: Absolute filesystem roots exposed by this Slave.

capabilities.prompt: Remote capability allowlist for this Slave.
